title: keel.cad.structure/v1
description: A neutral CAD product structure: the parts of an assembly and how many of each part every assembly contains. A CAD connector or script produces it; Keel turns it into a proposed EBOM that people review (docs/integration/cad-connector.md).

source.description: Where the structure came from. Informational; shown on the proposal.

system.description: The CAD system, for example NX, Creo, SolidWorks, CATIA or a script name.

root.description: The ref of the top part. It must not be used by any other part.

ref.description: The CAD system's own key for the part. Unique in the file.

number.description: A Keel part number when the CAD part already has one; the part is then matched by number.

partType.description: A part type of your administrator's list. Default: Assembly for a part with children, Component otherwise.

unit.description: A unit of your administrator's list. Default: EA.

source.description: A source of your administrator's list. Default: Make for an assembly, Buy otherwise.

attributes.description: Part attributes your administrator defined. Used when a missing part is created. Values are text, numbers or true/false.

matchOn.description: When there is no number match: attribute values that identify an existing part, tried in order. One match is used; several matches need a decision in the review.

parent.description: The ref of the containing part.

child.description: The ref of the contained part.
